def transform(grid):
    # Split the vertical stack into panels, then order by foreground-cell
    # count, using color as a tie-breaker.
    cuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 6 for v in row)]
    bounds = [-1] + cuts + [len(grid)]
    panels = []
    for i in range(len(bounds) - 1):
        panel = [row[:] for row in grid[bounds[i] + 1:bounds[i + 1]]]
        colors = [v for row in panel for v in row if v not in (6, 7)]
        if colors:
            panels.append((len(colors), min(colors), panel))

    panels.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
    out = []
    for i, (_, _, panel) in enumerate(panels):
        if i:
            out.append([6] * len(panel[0]))
        out.extend(panel)
    return out

        out.extend([row[:] for row in panels[i]])

    cuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 6 for v in row)]
    bounds = [-1] + cuts + [len(grid)]

    for i in range(len(bounds) - 1):
        panel = [row[:] for row in grid[bounds[i] + 1:bounds[i + 1]]]

            max(c for r, c in cells) - min(c for r, c in cells) + 1

    out = []
    for i, (_, panel) in enumerate(panels):
        if i:
            out.append([6] * len(panel[0]))
        out.extend(panel)
    return out
